chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Abū Maryam al-Anṣārī, from Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام), who said:

I said to him, "How was the salat upon the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم)?" He said, "When Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) had washed him and shrouded him, he covered him. Then he admitted ten people to him, and they stood around him. Then Amīr al-Muʾminīn (عليه السلام) stood in their midst and said:"
Surely Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet. O you who believe, send blessings upon him and submit with complete submission.
So the people would say as he was saying, until the people of al-Madīnah and the people of al-ʿAwālī had performed salat over him.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Amīr al-Muʾminīn, the title of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the salat, here referring to the funeral prayer and blessings upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعَوَالِيِ: the outlying upper districts around al-Madīnah
key_terms.غَسَّلَهُ: washed him, referring to the ritual washing of the Prophet’s body
key_terms.يُصَلُّونَ: send blessings, referring to Allah and the angels blessing the Prophet

ai.seo_question: How was the funeral salat upon the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم performed according to al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith describes how the funeral salat over the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was conducted under the direction of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It also cites the Quranic command to send blessings upon the Prophet, showing that the people repeated this verse as part of honoring him after his passing.
